topic: Starting with AI using a low-cost, SOP-led pilot

sources.title: ChatGPT Free Tier FAQ
sources.claim: Free tier provides everyday text chat and several tools, with separate feature limits; availability and limits can change.

sources.title: Projects in ChatGPT
sources.claim: Projects group related chats, files, and instructions for ongoing work.

sources.title: Scheduled tasks in ChatGPT
sources.claim: A scheduled task created in a project cannot access files uploaded or stored in that project.

sources.title: Scheduled task walkthrough
sources.claim: Scheduled workflows should be run and refined, then monitored from task results; local-only work depends on the computer being available.
